content_data.meeting_title: Campaign Performance Review & European Expansion Strategy
agenda_items: Integration of workflow automation tools into marketing operations
Discuss customer engagement trends and retention data from pilot workflow optimization platform
Plan influencer partnership program for sustainable food-tech initiatives
key_decisions: Agreed to shift focus from B2C to B2B marketing for enterprise workflow solutions
